results.prompt:
Black to move. Use the checked outcomes below to choose a sensible casual move.
American rules: Black men advance toward rank 1; Red men toward rank 8. A jump goes two diagonal squares over an adjacent enemy and removes it. Men jump forward only. A king is a crowned checker: it steps or jumps diagonally both ways and can be captured. Captures and complete multi-jumps are compulsory; crowning ends the turn. All listed actions are legal.
BOARD NOW:
Black (you): king b4.
Red (human): king h8.
Material: Black 1 pieces; Red 1 pieces; balance 0 points.
Capture required now: no. Quiet turns 0/80; third repetition draws.
LAST 5 TURNS (oldest first):
none
HOW TO READ OUTCOMES:
Each card is a separate possible next board. Red moves next. Exchange points use man=1, king=2 and include this move, every legal Red reply, and Black's best immediate material response; the displayed net is the worst of those checked branches, not a deeper evaluation. King distance is only a quiet activity hint, not safety. King escape facts count actual Red replies with no legal Black capture of that king on the following turn; fewer replies alone is not a benefit if Black loses material. Returning to an earlier square can be necessary.

Move king b4 to a5 | No capture; Checked exchange net: Black breaks even at 0 points; No immediate Red win; Red has no immediate legal capture; Red has 1 legal complete replies from 1 pieces; Red king safe replies: h8 1/1; King distance to nearest Red 6 to 7 diagonal steps.
Move king b4 to c5 | No capture; Checked exchange net: Black breaks even at 0 points; No immediate Red win; Red has no immediate legal capture; Red has 1 legal complete replies from 1 pieces; Red king safe replies: h8 1/1; King distance to nearest Red 6 to 5 diagonal steps.
Move king b4 to c3 | No capture; Checked exchange net: Black breaks even at 0 points; No immediate Red win; Red has no immediate legal capture; Red has 1 legal complete replies from 1 pieces; Red king safe replies: h8 1/1; King distance to nearest Red 6 to 5 diagonal steps.
SAFE QUIET PROGRESS: Move king b4 to c5; Move king b4 to c3. These advance a man or bring a king closer without a checked loss or simply undoing its previous move. This is an activity hint, not a forced win; prefer purposeful progress when no tactic decides.

results.systemPrompt: Choose one legal Black action using the verified checkers outcomes. Win now or force a win; otherwise prevent Red's immediate win. Each card is a separate alternative. Card order is not a recommendation.
